tags.notes: Authorization requires an initial HTTP request to get a token, so Transitland uses a custom script to fetch this feed. Also supersedes five Taichung-hosted intercity bus feeds whose host gtfs.taichung.gov.tw no longer resolves: their last feed versions date from 2019 and 2021, one never produced one at all, and fetches have failed since 2023-04-14. Fifteen of their sixteen operators appear in this bundle; the sixteenth, 仁友客運, ceased operating on 2026-02-25 having already transferred its routes to 中鹿客運, which is present.
